breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error verbatim, using parallel-flow temperature differences (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,in and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,out) for a counterflow heat exchanger. The ground truth requires counterflow temperature differences: ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in. The agent did not correct this inconsistency.
